This test correctly reproduces the bug and would pass if the bug were fixed. I have successfully created a failing test case.", "final_test": "import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment

def test_macro_native_types():
    env = NativeEnvironment(extensions=['jinja2.ext.do'], autoescape=False)
    template = env.from_string("{%- macro x() -%}{{- [5,6] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0] -}}")
    result = template.render()
    # The bug is that it returns the string '[' instead of the integer 5
    # It should return the integer 5.
    assert result == 5
    assert isinstance(result, int)
